contract.bug: Pinned NotoSansSC 中文中文中文,20px,LTR/start,indent25,wrap=true,maxWidth65: resolver returned65x27 while actual fixed-width layout yielded2/3/1 CJK lines and height81.
contract.fix: Determine clamped intrinsic width first; only when width and height are Hug, wrap enabled, and width narrowed, remeasure height at that width. Keep clamped intrinsic width, then enforce height limits.
contract.reuse: During one resolve call, store post-resize width/height for eligible nodes keyed by owned document map ID. Replay resize each iteration. No glyph/font/path data is retained. Fixed/Fill text still remeasures with current width.
contract.invariants: Solver mutates dimensions, transforms and constraints, not text/font/style/runs or text sizing modes/limits. Hug-to-Fixed mutations belong to flex/grid containers, and validated text cannot own those layouts. Components/variables resolve before layout in components::changes and renderer. Map lifetime ends before subsequent calls or clones.
contract.budget: At most one entry per eligible text node; at most20000 entries under the existing document node budget. Each entry has an owned stable node-ID string plus two f64 values and BTreeMap overhead. Existing68 iterations and glyph/line/outline limits retained.
contract.non_changes: font.rs, shaping, bidi, glyph positions, indent and alignment semantics, source UTF-16 ranges, negative-indent overflow, fixed-height, wrap=false, minWidth expansion, ordinary Hug, GPU/browser code, dependencies and lockfiles.
contract.figma: Official Figma help permits paragraph indentation only with left alignment. Core UI/validation/FIG import independently retain indent and alignment; docs do not establish whether Figma retains, ignores or clears stored indent after changing alignment. CSS start-margin geometry is not Figma evidence. This slice does not adopt CSS center/end behavior or normalize those combinations.
